paraphrased_notes: RFAMP wraps RFAMP_HO and exposes OP1dB, OPSAT, OIP2 and OIP3.
The documented RFAMP maximum-order selector lists orders through eleven.
RFAMP_HO derives polynomial coefficients from its IMN intermodulation list.
Higher-order products may overlap lower-order frequencies; arbitrary intercept choices need not represent a physical amplifier.
The documented guideline is IP4=P1dB+13 dB, IP6=P1dB+11 dB, IP8=P1dB+9 dB and IP10=P1dB+8 dB.
Odd coefficients of orders five, seven, nine and eleven are derived by proprietary algorithms from OP1dB, OPSAT and OIP3; this page supplies no exact coefficient formula.
The model maximum order cannot exceed the System Analysis maximum order.

interpretation: This diagnostic applies the fourth-order guideline to output-referred intercepts. Fifth-order coefficients are experimentally fitted, not derived from a published exact formula.
